label: club_itemmachine_msg_first_00
text: Thanks for opting in to set up one of our new\nItem Printers!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_first_01
text: I’m a member of the Science Club—we\ndeveloped this device.

label: club_itemmachine_msg_first_02
text: I’ll be right here to help you use it—if it’s not too\nmuch trouble to have me in your clubroom.

label: club_itemmachine_msg_first_03
text: So! Straight to it! What is the Item Printer?

label: club_itemmachine_msg_first_04
text: If you put materials dropped by Pokémon into\nthis printer—along with some BP—you’ll be able\r\nto get items in exchange!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_first_05
text: The exact inner workings are our little secret.\nWe’re in the midst of applying for a patent, see...

label: club_itemmachine_msg_first_06
text: But all you need to know is that it takes materials\nand lets you print items—and it’s fantastic!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_first_07
text: It’s really exciting to see what might come out!\nAnd it’s so simple to use! With that in mind—

label: club_itemmachine_msg_start_00
text: Would you like to print some items with the\nItem Printer?

label: club_itemmachine_msg_00_00
text: You all ready to save your progress and use up\n[VAR 0x0204(0001,002C)] BP to carry out this print job?

label: club_itemmachine_msg_00_02
text: You all ready to save your progress and use up\n[VAR 0x0204(0001,002C)] BP to carry out these [VAR 0x0201(0002)] print jobs?

label: club_itemmachine_msg_00_03
text: Erm... Seems that you’re lacking materials!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_00_04
text: Erm... Seems like you don’t have enough BP!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_00_05
text: Saving...\nPlease wait.

label: club_itemmachine_msg_01_00
text: All done! I’ll go ahead and put this in your Bag!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_01_01
text: All done! I’ll go ahead and put these in your Bag!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_02_00
text: Oooh, lucky! Looks like the 2× Item Bonus\nhas been activated!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_02_01
text: Oh?! Looks like you’ve activated the Poké Ball\nLotto!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_03_00
text: Changed your mind? I can give you back your\nmaterials.

label: club_itemmachine_msg_04_00
text: You’ve really put the Item Printer through its\npaces! In fact, I think we have enough data now\r\nto make some improvements!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_04_01
text: You’ve really put the Item Printer through the\nwringer! I’d say it’s ready for another upgrade.

label: club_itemmachine_msg_04_02
text: Thanks to you making heavy use of the Item\nPrinter, we should be able to do some work\r\non it and get it to its final version!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_powerup_00
text: It’ll cost [VAR 0x0204(0001,002C)] BP to make improvements to the\nItem Printer... Is that OK?

label: club_itemmachine_msg_powerup_01
text: Roger that! I’ll get right to work on upgrading\nthe Item Printer!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_powerup_02
text: Hi-yah! A little grease here, and...

label: club_itemmachine_msg_powerup_03
text:
Phew... The upgrade’s all done!\c
You shouldn’t need as much BP or materials
for print jobs now!\c
We also added a new [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]2× Item Bonus[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] function!
You might sometimes get double the items!\c
Oh, also, it doesn’t help the Item Printer work
any better, but I made it look like a Great Ball!
Now that that’s done...

label: club_itemmachine_msg_powerup_04
text:
Phew... The Item Printer’s second upgrade is
all done!\c
You should need even less BP and fewer
materials for print jobs now!\c
And the new [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Poké Ball Lotto [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]function could give
you a shot at printing rare Poké Balls!\c
Oh, also, it doesn’t help the Item Printer work
any better, but I made it look like an Ultra Ball!
Now that that’s done...

label: club_itemmachine_msg_powerup_05
text:
Phew... The Item Printer’s final upgrade is
all done!\c
The Item Printer can now print multiples of the
same item!\c
And it can print Stellar Tera Shards now!\c
Oh, also, it doesn’t help the Item Printer work
any better, but I made it look like a Master Ball!\c
I really appreciate you taking part in our
research! Now that that’s done...

label: club_itemmachine_msg_powerup_ng_00
text: Hmmm, we’re going to need to collect more data\nto do that... Try doing more print jobs!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_powerup_ng_01
text: The Item Printer is already upgraded all the way\nto its final version, silly!

label: club_itemmachine_msg_powerup_ng_02
text: I’m looking into new ways to upgrade the Item\nPrinter now, but it may take some time!
